people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by Paul, and blasphemed.
translations.bsb: But when the Jews saw the crowds, they were filled with jealousy, and they blasphemously contradicted what Paul was saying.
translations.kjv: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting and blaspheming.
translations.asv: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by Paul, and blasphemed.
